title: Bumblebee dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='32' rx='14' ry='9' fill='#c8e8ff' transform='rotate(-25 33 32)'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='32' rx='14' ry='9' fill='#c8e8ff' transform='rotate(25 67 32)'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='37' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#eaf6ff' transform='rotate(-20 36 37)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='37' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#eaf6ff' transform='rotate(20 64 37)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='22' ry='26' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- stripes -->
  <path d='M30 48 Q50 42 70 48 L70 56 Q50 50 30 56 Z' fill='#3a2f6e'/>
  <path d='M29 64 Q50 58 71 64 L71 72 Q50 66 29 72 Z' fill='#3a2f6e'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='33' r='14' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='31' r='3.5' fill='#2b2354'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='31' r='3.5' fill='#2b2354'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 38 Q50 42 55 38' stroke='#2b2354' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <line x1='44' y1='21' x2='38' y2='12' stroke='#3a2f6e' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='11' r='3' fill='#ff6b9d'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='21' x2='62' y2='12' stroke='#3a2f6e' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='11' r='3' fill='#ff6b9d'/>
  <!-- dancing arms -->
  <path d='M29 52 Q18 46 14 34' stroke='#3a2f6e' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='13' cy='33' r='3.5' fill='#ff6b9d'/>
  <path d='M71 52 Q82 46 86 34' stroke='#3a2f6e' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='87' cy='33' r='3.5' fill='#ff6b9d'/>
  <!-- dancing legs -->
  <path d='M40 82 Q36 90 30 92' stroke='#3a2f6e' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 82 Q64 90 70 92' stroke='#3a2f6e' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- shoes -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='93' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ff6b9d'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='93' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ff6b9d'/>
  <!-- stinger -->
  <path d='M50 84 L50 90' stroke='#3a2f6e' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little sparkles around it -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='22' r='2' fill='#ffe873'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='22' r='2' fill='#ffe873'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='58' r='2' fill='#ffe873'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='58' r='2' fill='#ffe873'/>
</svg>
